source_order: Read the three alternating overlays first (6c8f85cf..., bdd6149c..., 6a9572f4...). Then read this erratum completely. Only then read the affected packet. The packet bytes are unchanged; this file is additive.

corrections.severity: MINOR: incomplete justification; the conclusion is unchanged
corrections.location: Section 2, paragraph after Lemma U, the sentences 'Consequently (q^{1/k})^m≡±1 would force ek|2m. That fails in each row below, since ek>e and m≤e with ε as listed, so every α or β condition holds.'
corrections.defect: Since q^{1/k} has order ek modulo r, the congruence (q^{1/k})^m ≡ −1 forces ek|2m but not ek|m. Together with m≤e and ek≥2e, this is possible exactly when k=2 and m=e. The stated inference therefore needs the sign ε, and the packet did not spell this out.
corrections.replacement_argument: If (q^{1/k})^m≡+1 (mod r), then ek|m, which is impossible because ek≥2e>m. If (q^{1/k})^m≡−1, then ek|2m and ek∤m; since 2m≤2e≤ek this forces k=2 and m=e. Hence the condition (q^{1/k})^m≢ε holds for every prime k|f whenever m<e, or whenever ε=+1.
corrections.rows_used_exactly: Re-read from the already pinned BBGT HTML (SHA 6cf5530f8386133e7208e6e0b77b1b44de78d8546549f2c3faf5144d403f9bfc), Table C TeX source: G2(q), r_6: α(3,−1) [m=3<e=6]; ³D4(q), r_12: (q^{1/k})^6≢−1 for k∈π(f)∖{3,r} [m=6<e=12]; F4(q), r_8: p≥3 and α(4,−1) [m=4<e=8]; E6(q), r_9: α(9,1) [ε=+1]; ²E6(q), r_18: β(9,1) [ε=+1, m=9<e=18]; E7(q), r_18: α(18,1) [ε=+1]; E8(q), r_30: α(30,1) [ε=+1]. No row used has ε=−1 together with m=e, so every α/β condition holds, as the packet asserted.

corrections.severity: MINOR: omitted case; the conclusion is unchanged
corrections.location: Section 3, proof of Lemma Q, the sentence 'Item (13) occurs only in PSL2(7), and (11) for f=2 only in PSL2(49).' and the bullet list after it
corrections.defect: Maslova item (11), H≅PGL2(q_0) in PSL2(q) with q=q_0^2, also occurs for every even f≥4, and the bullet list does not treat it.
corrections.replacement_argument: Its index is (q(q^2−1)/2)/(q_0(q_0^2−1)) = q_0(q_0^2+1)/2, whose 7-adic valuation is f/2. That is 1 only for f=2, which is PSL2(49), excluded from Lemma Q. For every even f≥4 the valuation is at least 2, as Lemma Q requires.
